description: This file defines the `EmrClient` class within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the Amazon Elastic MapReduce (EMR) service. It includes detailed PHPDoc annotations for various methods that correspond to EMR operations, enabling developers to invoke these operations through the client.

classes.name: EmrClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon EMR service, extending the generic AwsClient to provide EMR-specific methods.

methods.name: addInstanceFleet
methods.description: Adds an instance fleet to an EMR cluster.

methods.name: addInstanceGroups
methods.description: Adds one or more instance groups to a cluster.

methods.name: addJobFlowSteps
methods.description: Adds steps to a running EMR job flow.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds tags to an EMR resource.

methods.name: cancelSteps
methods.description: Cancels specified steps in a cluster.

methods.name: createSecurityConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a security configuration for EMR clusters.

methods.name: createStudio
methods.description: Creates a new EMR Studio.

methods.name: createStudioSessionMapping
methods.description: Creates a new mapping between an IAM user and a Studio.

methods.name: deleteSecurityConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes a security configuration.

methods.name: deleteStudio
methods.description: Deletes an EMR Studio.

methods.name: deleteStudioSessionMapping
methods.description: Deletes a Studio session mapping.

methods.name: describeCluster
methods.description: Provides details about an EMR cluster.

methods.name: describeJobFlows
methods.description: Provides details of one or more job flows (clusters).

methods.name: describeNotebookExecution
methods.description: Returns information about a notebook execution.

methods.name: describeReleaseLabel
methods.description: Describes a release label for EMR.

methods.name: describeSecurityConfiguration
methods.description: Returns details of a security configuration.

methods.name: describeStep
methods.description: Provides details for a specific step.

methods.name: describeStudio
methods.description: Returns information about an EMR Studio.

methods.name: getAutoTerminationPolicy
methods.description: Gets the auto-termination policy for a cluster.

methods.name: getBlockPublicAccessConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the block public access configuration.

methods.name: getClusterSessionCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves session credentials for a cluster.

methods.name: getManagedScalingPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves information about a managed scaling policy.

methods.name: getStudioSessionMapping
methods.description: Retrieves the session mapping for a Studio.

methods.name: listBootstrapActions
methods.description: Lists bootstrap actions associated with a cluster.

methods.name: listClusters
methods.description: Lists all clusters.

methods.name: listInstanceFleets
methods.description: Lists the instance fleets that belong to a cluster.

methods.name: listInstanceGroups
methods.description: Lists the instance groups for a cluster.

methods.name: listInstances
methods.description: Lists the EC2 instances in a cluster.

methods.name: listNotebookExecutions
methods.description: Lists notebook executions.

methods.name: listReleaseLabels
methods.description: Lists release labels for EMR.

methods.name: listSecurityConfigurations
methods.description: Lists security configurations.

methods.name: listSteps
methods.description: Lists all steps for a cluster.

methods.name: listStudioSessionMappings
methods.description: Lists session mappings for a Studio.

methods.name: listStudios
methods.description: Lists all EMR Studios.

methods.name: listSupportedInstanceTypes
methods.description: Lists supported instance types.

methods.name: modifyCluster
methods.description: Modifies an existing cluster.

methods.name: modifyInstanceFleet
methods.description: Modifies an instance fleet.

methods.name: modifyInstanceGroups
methods.description: Modify one or more instance groups.

methods.name: putAutoScalingPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates an auto-scaling policy.

methods.name: putAutoTerminationPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates the auto-termination policy.

methods.name: putBlockPublicAccessConfiguration
methods.description: Creates or updates the block public access configuration.

methods.name: putManagedScalingPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates the managed scaling policy.

methods.name: removeAutoScalingPolicy
methods.description: Removes an auto-scaling policy.

methods.name: removeAutoTerminationPolicy
methods.description: Removes the auto-termination policy.

methods.name: removeManagedScalingPolicy
methods.description: Removes a managed scaling policy.

methods.name: removeTags
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: runJobFlow
methods.description: Creates and starts a new EMR cluster.

methods.name: setKeepJobFlowAliveWhenNoSteps
methods.description: Sets whether the cluster should stay alive when no steps are running.

methods.name: setTerminationProtection
methods.description: Enables or disables termination protection.

methods.name: setUnhealthyNodeReplacement
methods.description: Sets whether unhealthy nodes should be replaced.

methods.name: setVisibleToAllUsers
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the resource to all users.

methods.name: startNotebookExecution
methods.description: Starts a notebook execution.

methods.name: stopNotebookExecution
methods.description: Stops a notebook execution.

methods.name: terminateJobFlows
